original.statement: Loki now automatically attempts to populate a `service_name` label on ingestion.

decision.reason: [ev-8c0cecc71daf] says Loki 3.0.0 will now automatically try to populate a `service_name` label on ingestion. That is a change in how ingestion behaves at runtime for the same configuration, so behavior-changed fits. No config key, flag or field is named, so protocol-behavior with the kebab-case name "service-name-label-autopopulation", built from the excerpt's own key words, is a reasonable subject. Applicability and consequence are not under review here.
